description: This file provides compatibility wrappers for using the 'uci' command in the OpenWrt project. It defines functions to load, set, revert, toggle, add, remove, and commit configuration options via the 'uci' command, managing configurations for system services.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads the configuration for a given package, exporting environment variables based on UCI data.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration for a package if it does not already exist.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts UCI configuration to a previous state stored in /var/state.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific UCI configuration option in the stored state.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a UCI configuration option in sequence.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds a value to a list-type UCI option.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value from the stored state.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value, with optional default fallback.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new configuration section or sets a section type for a package.

methods.name: uci_rename
methods.description: Renames a UCI configuration option or section.

methods.name: uci_remove
methods.description: Removes a UCI configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes a specific value from a list-type UCI option.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts a UCI configuration option to its previous value.

methods.name: uci_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to a UCI package, making them persistent.
